documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our wholesale distribution team struggles with fragmented reporting. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's wholesale distribution team is struggling with 'fragmented reporting' and seeks 'workflow coordination and account reporting.' They have requested a discovery meeting to clarify their requirements but have not yet approved a budget. The account is in the 'qualified' stage with verified consent and ownership by 'cedar-east.' There is no approved price, deployment timeline, or vendor connector at this time.

claims.quote: Our wholesale distribution team struggles with fragmented reporting.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. I understand that your wholesale distribution team is struggling with fragmented reporting and that you are seeking workflow coordination and account reporting. To better understand your specific needs and how Cedar Systems can support you, I would like to schedule a discovery meeting. This will allow us to explore integration requirements and align on your goals. Please let me know a convenient time to proceed.
questions: What specific systems or tools are currently being used for reporting and workflow coordination?
Are there any particular pain points or inefficiencies you'd like to address with a new solution?
Do you have any preferred timelines for implementation or integration?
uncertainties: The customer has not approved a budget, which may impact the scope or timeline of the discovery meeting.
The exact nature of the 'fragmented reporting' is not specified, which may require further clarification during the discovery session.
